script.label: status
script.message: How far did you get with the route and retry policy? Give me the status, then carry on with the unfinished route work.

script.label: ruling
script.message:
Use the revised wait policy below and update the route spec and tests. This replaces the seconds-first policy you just built.

BoundedPolicy.hint: finite nonnegative retry-after-ms first, then retry-after. Malformed, negative, NaN and infinite hints are absent; try the other header. retry-after also accepts an HTTP date relative to now; past dates mean zero. Cap a valid hint at max_delay * 4, not max_delay. Missing hint returns None. delay keeps bounded exponential fallback. Exhausted quota returns the ceiling of the hint, minimum one second. Legacy retry and provider code stay unchanged.

script.label: scope
script.message:
Add the catalog and offline release assessment below. The endpoint and evidence adapter are independent parts. Commit and document them.

GET /v2/routes needs no credentials or provider call. Return catalog.public_catalog(settings); POST is 405 even without credentials. Entries are sorted by path and have only path, default_model, aliases, max_tokens=4096.

Implement chatsvc.readiness.assess(snapshot, expected_revision, expected_catalog), pure and nonmutating. Return exactly ready(bool), reasons(sorted unique codes), revision(snapshot string or empty). Report independent failures: environment unless env=stage; revision unless nonempty and equals expected_revision; dirty unless exactly false; checks unless nonempty list with unique nonempty names, each ok exactly true at expected_revision; smoke unless ok exactly true at expected_revision; catalog unless exactly expected_catalog, sorted unique absolute paths, nonempty default_model, string aliases and only the four public fields; code unless deployed_files/current_files are string maps with matching chatsvc/ and config/ entries and at least one of each. Ignore docs differences. Wrong types fail closed, no exception.

Implement chatsvc.stage_receipts.review(records, revision, catalog, deployed_files, current_files). Records have action(check/deploy/smoke), revision, sequence(int), ok(bool), and check name or deploy env/dirty. Select latest check per name across revisions; failed latest check replaces success. Select latest deploy/smoke for revision; smoke must follow deploy. Duplicate sequences within an action/name are invalid (ValueError). Build the assess snapshot, without Git or environment calls. No receipt is evidence until an actual check or deploy makes it.

script.label: info
script.message:
Review caught a defect in the job report: the spool replays events and workers reuse request ids. Fix its counting through the shared diagnostics, not only a saved report.

Extend diagnostics.summarize and scripts/provider_report.py. Retain legacy records, decoding model paths. For records with worker,request,event, deduplicate by (worker,event); an identity with conflicting contents is ValueError. Group by (worker,request), order by attempt; reject gaps, changed models or a retry after a final response. Ignore inbound lines. Return calls,retries,statuses,paths,models plus duplicates and requests (sorted worker,request; each has worker,request,attempts,status). Preserve legacy line counting when metadata is absent; incomplete metadata is invalid. Save this capture as traffic/incident.log, run the CLI into reports/provider.json, add regression tests, and explain the alias/404 and shared-quota/429 causes in docs/provider-incident.md. Commit the fix.
